tasks.short: Inspect MRI images for quality using scanner equipment and laser camera.

steps.what: Locate the correct MRI series and quality reference using native scanner and image views
inputs: actual acquired image series
existing approved image quality reference
outputs: technologist-checked image series and quality context

steps.what: Inspect images on the scanner and laser camera output and judge image quality
inputs: technologist-checked image series and quality context
actual scanner display and laser camera output
outputs: technologist quality findings and required corrective decisions

steps.what: Write and approve actual image quality findings against the correct patient and series
inputs: technologist quality findings and required corrective decisions
outputs: approved final actual quality inspection note

steps.what: Save the approved final image quality note
inputs: approved final actual quality inspection note
outputs: saved actual quality inspection

tasks.design: Configure native {SCANNER_CONSOLE} and {IMAGE_ARCHIVE} series navigation, denoted OTHER. Retain visual inspection on scanner equipment and laser camera output, quality judgement and actual note writing. No image model makes a quality or clinical decision. Same-system save is separate and earns no saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding the right series and reference may require repeated navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native scanner and image views can expose current series and approved reference links.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising artefacts and whether images meet the actual examination need.
tasks.human_edge: The technologist relates image appearance to acquisition conditions and patient movement.
tasks.altitude: Human image quality inspection with native series retrieval.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native scanner and image archive views can retrieve existing image series and reference links.

assumptions: Shares are provisional; credit only residual navigation after current scanner features. Acquisition and equipment runtime earn no new benefit.

Scanner creates existing patient_id, study_id, series_id and acquisition_time. s1 verifies patient, series and reference currency; absent or inconsistent metadata requires manual retrieval. No new upstream recording is assumed.
s3 captures actual observed_artefact, quality_assessment and required_action at full time. The saved note does not execute repeat scanning or certify diagnosis. Same-system save remains full.
research_questions: Does the current scanner already show the required series and approved quality references together?

incremental.description: Check image view and approved reference mappings

approvals.approved_version: s3 actual final quality note with patient and series identity

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only retrieval changes: 15 times 30% = 4.5 hours minus 1 upkeep = 3.5. Low halves retrieval benefit: 2.25 minus 1 = 1.25.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Create backup copies by transferring images to storage media or a workstation.

steps.what: Select and check actual studies and series for backup using native batch selection
inputs: actual source image studies and series
approved backup scope
outputs: technologist-checked source image selection

steps.what: Prepare the exact backup manifest, permitted destination and access settings
inputs: technologist-checked source image selection
actual permitted destination and storage availability
outputs: complete candidate image backup manifest and destination

steps.what: Approve the final exact source images, destination and backup access settings
inputs: complete candidate image backup manifest and destination
outputs: approved final backup manifest, destination and permissions

steps.what: Initiate the approved image transfer to the approved storage media or workstation
inputs: approved final backup manifest, destination and permissions
outputs: actual image transfer result

steps.what: Verify actual copied image counts, identities, readability and available integrity checks
inputs: actual image transfer result
approved final backup manifest, destination and permissions
outputs: actual verified backup result and exceptions

steps.what: Write and approve actual backup outcome and any unresolved transfer failures
inputs: actual verified backup result and exceptions
outputs: approved final actual backup log entry

steps.what: Save the approved final backup log entry
inputs: approved final actual backup log entry
outputs: saved actual backup record

tasks.design: Configure native batch study/series selection in {IMAGE_ARCHIVE}, denoted OTHER, before considering any new integration. The technologist checks the exact manifest and destination before a separate transfer action. Verify actual copy outcome afterwards. Existing transfer runtime, transfer initiation and same-system log save earn no saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Selecting many actual series individually may require repeated operator actions.
tasks.enabler_now: Native study-level batch selection can reduce those actions while retaining checks.
tasks.still_hard: Ensuring the backup has the correct images, permissions and readable complete content.
tasks.human_edge: The technologist identifies failed or wrong-patient transfers and resolves them.
tasks.altitude: Native batch selection with verified image backup.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native image archives can select studies and series for a batch export where enabled.

assumptions: All shares are provisional operator effort, excluding transfer wait/runtime. Measure actual repeated selection after current native functions; already batched backups earn no benefit.

Scanner/archive already supplies study_id, series_id and image_count. s1 retains 15 hours for actual selection and identity checks; s2 captures destination_id, permitted_scope and access settings at full time. Missing identifiers or batch support uses manual selection.

s5 retains full actual copy verification; no backup success is inferred from starting the transfer. s6 captures actual copied_count, verification_result and failure_detail afterwards. Both writes are individually gated and unchanged.
research_questions: Is any backup selection still per-series after current native archive export functions?

incremental.description: Maintain batch selection settings and audit export scope

approvals.approved_version: s3 exact final backup manifest, destination and permissions
s6 actual final backup result log

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only repeated selection changes: 30 times 50% = 15 operator hours less 1 upkeep = 14. Low halves selection benefit: 7.5 minus 1 = 6.5. Existing transfer and save earn no benefit.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Instruct medical staff and students in MRI procedures and equipment operation.

steps.what: Find and check the current approved MRI training procedure and equipment instructions
inputs: actual equipment model and software revision
existing approved MRI training materials
outputs: technologist-checked current training sources

steps.what: Demonstrate MRI procedures and equipment operation and check actual learner understanding
inputs: technologist-checked current training sources
actual learners and training equipment
outputs: actual instruction and learner performance observations

steps.what: Write and approve actual instruction, observed learner performance and remaining training needs
inputs: actual instruction and learner performance observations
outputs: approved final actual MRI training note

steps.what: Save the approved final MRI training note
inputs: approved final actual MRI training note
outputs: saved actual training note

tasks.design: Configure native approved procedure links in {LMS} against the actual {SCANNER_CONSOLE} model/revision, denoted OTHER. Keep demonstration, explanation and competence judgement human. Actual training observations follow instruction; separate same-system save earns no saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding the exact current equipment training procedure can require repeat navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native approved-document links can reduce retrieval only.
tasks.still_hard: Teaching safe operation and recognising incomplete understanding.
tasks.human_edge: The technologist responds to actual learner actions around MRI equipment.
tasks.altitude: Human MRI instruction with current training source retrieval.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native learning and document systems can link approved equipment training procedures by model and revision.

assumptions: Provisional shares require actual residual retrieval after current training links; existing materials and runtime earn no new saving.
Equipment register and training owner supply existing model_id, software_revision and approved_training_version. s1 retains currency checks; missing links require manual lookup.

s3 captures actual learner_id, instruction_date, procedure_taught, observed_performance and remaining_need at full time after instruction. Attendance does not automatically certify competence. Same-system save remains full.
research_questions: Are current approved MRI training procedures already directly available in the learning system?

incremental.description: Maintain training links and equipment revision correspondence

approvals.approved_version: s3 actual final MRI training note and learner

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only retrieval changes: 10 times 30% = 3 hours less 0.5 upkeep = 2.5. Low halves retrieval benefit: 1.5 minus 0.5 = 1.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Write reports or notes summarizing MRI procedures and outcomes for medical professionals.

steps.what: Verify and capture actual MRI procedures, patient response and authorised outcome information
inputs: actual performed scan records and technologist observations
actual authorised clinical outcome entries
outputs: technologist-checked examination source set

steps.what: Populate exact performed-procedure fields in the native examination note template
inputs: technologist-checked examination source set
approved MRI note template
outputs: source-linked factual examination note draft

steps.what: Draft and correct the variable procedure narrative against actual examination sources
inputs: source-linked factual examination note draft
technologist-checked examination source set
outputs: complete corrected examination note draft

loop.purpose: Summarise actual performed procedures and documented response without making a diagnosis
loop.input: checked actual scan records, technologist observations and authorised outcome entries
loop.output: candidate procedural narrative with source references and explicit gaps
loop.check: Technologist checks patient identity, performed versus planned procedures, chronology, omissions, adverse responses and every outcome assertion against actual sources; corrects all text
loop.stop: Missing clinical source, contradiction or two failed corrections returns writing to technologist
loop.why_not_simpler: Native templates handle exact fields first; variable procedural exceptions and observed response need semantic drafting and full checking

steps.what: Approve the complete final examination note, patient record and intended internal medical recipient
inputs: complete corrected examination note draft
technologist-checked examination source set
actual authorised internal medical recipient
outputs: approved final examination note, patient destination and internal recipient

steps.what: Save the approved final examination note to the approved patient record
inputs: approved final examination note, patient destination and internal recipient
outputs: saved final examination note

steps.what: Send the approved final examination note to the designated internal medical professional
inputs: saved final examination note
approved final examination note, patient destination and internal recipient
outputs: dispatched final note to authorised internal recipient

tasks.design: Configure {CLINICAL_RECORD} exact-field note templates before bounded narrative drafting; OTHER includes that record and its scanner source. The technologist captures and checks actual procedures, corrects all narrative and approves the complete note before separate save and internal dispatch. Both final actions remain fully retained.
tasks.previous_blocker: Performed-procedure facts and variable observations may be copied into a narrative note manually.
tasks.enabler_now: Native templates reuse exact fields; clinical documentation drafting can assist prose with full professional validation.
tasks.still_hard: Accurately distinguishing actual procedures, observations and authorised clinical conclusions.
tasks.human_edge: The technologist knows what happened and does not substitute a draft for clinical interpretation.
tasks.altitude: Verified procedural reporting for medical colleagues.

evidence.claim: Clinical documentation systems can summarise consultations for validation; applying this to procedural MRI notes remains a proposed extension requiring testing.

assumptions: All shares and retained effort are provisional; measure residual note copying and drafting after current native features. No local time study or clinical outcome benefit is invented.

Scanner supplies actual patient_id, study_id, performed_sequence and acquisition_time. s1 retains full checking and capture of actual patient_response, procedural_exception and any authorised_outcome source. Missing fields require manual writing; no planned protocol stands for performed work.
s3 retains 15 hours for full semantic correction; s4 retains 26 for complete clinical/factual and destination review. The draft does not interpret images or prescribe action.

This instance sends within the organisation using existing authorised routing. External transfer requires act_external authority and fresh recipient review. Save and send remain full; changed text or destination returns to s4 before either action.
research_questions: Do fully corrected procedural drafts reduce total technologist effort after native templates?

incremental.description: Audit procedural omissions and maintain clinical template mappings

approvals.approved_version: s4 complete final examination note and patient record
s4 complete final examination note and exact internal medical recipient

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central saves 20 exact-field assembly and 10 corrected narrative hours less 2 upkeep = 28. Low halves only exact-field benefit and keeps narrative manual: 10 minus 2 = 8. Save and send earn no saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Human MRI quality, instruction and reporting with checked native assistance.
reach: Less repeated selection, retrieval and note assembly
role.ambitious_version: Technologists retain quality and patient-related judgement while using native selection and templates for genuinely residual clerical work.
